title: Amazon.nl: ordinary return 40 days after receipt
facts_text: I received a standard desk lamp from Amazon.nl 40 days ago. It is unused, complete, and not defective, damaged, or incorrect. It is not customised and is not in an excluded product category. I have the receipt. No severe or unforeseen hardship prevented an earlier return.
request: I would like to return the lamp for a refund. Can you help?

strict.reason: The ordinary return is outside the 30-day voluntary window and the 14-day withdrawal window; no defect or other stated entitlement applies.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The stated severe unforeseen hardship condition is absent; the receipt and unused condition do not extend the return window.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The experimental policy leaves exceptional circumstances and slightly late returns undefined; approval is discretionary, subject to the supplied scope.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Synthetic customer case adapted to the new shared Amazon.nl policy. Timing is measured from receipt, as required by the supplied policy, rather than from purchase. No defective-product or excluded-category entitlement is implied. The ambiguous deadline extension remains undefined; references require human review.
